title: Air Force cooperation with Stargate

tellings.quote: In fact, two sitting Air Force Chiefs of Staff, Michael E. Ryan and John P. Jumper appeared on the show as themselves.

plain: Michels says that two sitting Air Force Chiefs of Staff, Michael E. Ryan and John P. Jumper, appeared as themselves on the TV series Stargate, the science fiction show (not the CIA program of the same name) that ran from 1997 and which he links to the actor Richard Dean Anderson. He tells it himself, without naming a source. He raises it as a sign that the Air Force worked closely with a show about secret space travel.
